lines.text: The Lord sends a message against Jacob, and the people of Ephraim and Samaria proudly vow to rebuild with finished stone.
The LORD raises up the foes of Rezin, and Aram from the east and Egypt from the west devour Israel.
The LORD will cut off head and tail in a single day; the head is the elder and the tail is the priest who takes bribes.
The land is scorched by the wrath of the LORD of Hosts, and Manasseh and Ephraim together turn against Judah.
Woe to those who make unjust laws against the poor, for nothing will remain but to crouch among captives or fall among the slain.
